arxiv-2107-02686.title: Measuring the electron Yukawa coupling via resonant s s -channel Higgs production at FCC-ee
arxiv-2107-02686.creator: David d’Enterria, Andres Poldaru, George Wojcik
arxiv-2107-02686.description: Abstract The Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee) offers the unique opportunity of studying the Higgs Yukawa coupling to the electron, y e y_{\mathrm{e}} , via resonant s s -channel production, e + ​ e − → H \mathrm{e^{+}e^{-}}\to\mathrm{H} , in a dedicated run at s = m H \sqrt{s}=m_{\mathrm{H}} .

arxiv-2202-00347.title: Finite-time enclosing control for multiple moving targets: a continuous estimator approach
arxiv-2202-00347.creator: Liang Zhang
arxiv-2202-00347.description: Abstract This work addresses the finite-time enclosing control problem where a set of followers are deployed to encircle and rotate around multiple moving targets with a predefined spacing pattern in finite time. A novel distributed and continuous estimator is firstly proposed to track the geometric center of targets in finite time using only local information for every follower.

arxiv-2305-07102.title: Salient Mask-Guided Vision Transformer for Fine-Grained Classification
arxiv-2305-07102.creator: Dmitry Demidov, Muhammad Hamza Sharif, Aliakbar Abdurahimov, Hisham Cholakkal and Fahad Shahbaz Khan Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Abu Dhabi, UAE { dmitry.demidov, muhammad.sharif, aliakbar.abdurahimov, hisham.cholakkal, fahad.khan } @mbzuai.ac.ae
arxiv-2305-07102.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dmitry Demidov, Muhammad Hamza Sharif, Aliakbar Abdurahimov, Hisham Cholakkal and Fahad Shahbaz Khan Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Abu Dhabi, UAE { dmitry.demidov, muhammad.sharif, aliakbar.abdurahimov, hisham.cholakkal, fahad.khan } @mbzuai.ac.ae. Fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) is a challenging computer vision problem, where the task is to automatically recognise objects from subordinate categories. One of its main difficulties is capturing the most discriminative inter-class variances among visually similar classes.

arxiv-2311-06649.title: A Template Is All You Meme
arxiv-2311-06649.creator: Luke Bates, Peter Ebert Christensen, Preslav Nakov, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2311-06649.description: Abstract Templatic memes, characterized by a semantic structure adaptable to the creator’s intent, represent a significant yet underexplored area within meme processing literature. With the goal of establishing a new direction for computational meme analysis, here we create a knowledge base composed of more than 5,200 meme templates, information about them, and 54,000 examples of template instances (templatic memes).

arxiv-2402-16562.title: QF-tuner: Breaking Tradition in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2402-16562.creator: Mahmood A. Jumaah, Yossra H. Ali, Tarik A. Rashid
arxiv-2402-16562.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mahmood A. Jumaah, Yossra H. Ali, Tarik A. Rashid. In reinforcement learning algorithms, the hyperparameters tuning method refers to choosing the optimal parameters that may increase the overall performance. Manual or random hyperparameter tuning methods can lead to different results in the reinforcement learning algorithms. In this paper, we propose a new method called QF-tuner for automatic hyperparameter tuning in the Q-learning algorithm using the FOX optimization algorithm (FOX).

arxiv-2407-03378.title: Theory of Complex Particle without

arxiv-2407-03378.description: Abstract Complex particle is a kind of bilocal particle having unexpected symmetry, which was proposed by the authour. In the present paper, we show that critical dimension of the complex particle in Minkowski spacetime is D = 4 D=4 , while D = 2 , 4 D=2,4 or 6 6 are permitted in Euclid spacetime.

arxiv-2509-15819.title: The basic ideas of quantum mechanics
arxiv-2509-15819.creator: David Ellerman
arxiv-2509-15819.description: Abstract For a century, quantum theorists have been reading the mathematical entrails of quantum mechanics (QM) to divine the nature of quantum reality. But to little avail. In this paper a different approach is taken, namely to identify and explain the basic intuitive ideas involved in QM.

pmc-10551100.title: Multidisciplinary strategies for managing acute watery diarrhea in children with congenital anorectal malformation and colostomy: A case study
pmc-10551100.creator: Mohammad Ashraful Amin, Ridwana Maher Manna, Sabrina Nahin, Mohammad Delwer Hossain Hawlader
pmc-10551100.description: Key clinical messageCongenital anorectal malformation (ARM) is a diverse group of anomalies affecting the development of the anal and rectal regions, with an estimated incidence of one in every 5000 live births. The colostomy is commonly performed as part of the staged management of children with ARM to prevent complications.

pmc-10670661.title: Pediatric Hyperglycemic Hyperosmolar Syndrome: A Comprehensive Approach to Diagnosis, Management, and Complications Utilizing Novel Summarizing Acronyms
pmc-10670661.creator: Naser Amin Zahran, Shaheen Jadidi
pmc-10670661.description: This paper focuses on hyperglycemic hyperosmolar syndrome (HHS), a unique hyperglycemic state requiring divergent diagnosis and treatment approaches from diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) despite some shared characteristics. We introduce the mnemonic DI-FF-ER-EN-CE-S to encapsulate unique HHS management and complications. ‘DI’ emphasizes the need to delay and decrease initial insulin therapy until serum glucose decline is managed by fluid resuscitation alone.

pmc-11396054.title: Compressor fault diagnosis and result visualization based on fusion of vision transformer and improved residual network
pmc-11396054.creator: Xianling Duan, Shaolin Hu, Sijing Wang, Ru Duan
pmc-11396054.description: Compressors are important production equipment in the petrochemical industry, and the accuracy of their fault diagnosis is critical. In order to detect and diagnose compressor equipment faults in a timely manner, this paper constructs a deep residual shrinkage visual network (DRS-ViT). The network comprises a modified residual network (ResNet) and a vision transformer (ViT).

pmc-11434051.title: Two-Dimensional Polarized Blue P/SiS Heterostructures as Promising Photocatalysts for Water Splitting
pmc-11434051.creator: Yin Liu, Di Gu, Xiaoma Tao, Yifang Ouyang, Chunyan Duan, Guangxing Liang, Yurii V Geletii
pmc-11434051.description: Two-dimensional (2D) polarized heterostructures with internal electric fields are potential photocatalysts for high catalytic performance. The Blue P/SiS van der Waals heterostructures were formed from monolayer Blue P and polar monolayer SiS with different stacking interfaces, including Si-P and P-S interfaces. The structural, electronic, optical and photocatalytic properties of the Blue P/SiS heterostructures were studied via first-principle calculations.

pmc-11483255.title: Association Between Climatic Factors and Varicella Incidence in Wuxi, East China, 2010-2019: Surveillance Study
pmc-11483255.creator: Kehong Zhang, Ganglei Shen, Yue Yuan, Chao Shi, Amaryllis Mavragani, Xiao Lin, Xiang Li
pmc-11483255.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundVaricella is a common infectious disease and a growing public health concern in China, with increasing outbreaks in Wuxi. Analyzing the correlation between climate factors and varicella incidence in Wuxi is crucial for guiding public health prevention efforts.ObjectiveThis study examines the impact of meteorological variables on varicella incidence in Wuxi, eastern China, from 2010 to 2019, offering insights for public health interventions.MethodsWe collected daily meteorological data and varicella case records from January 1, 2010, to December 31, 2019, in Wuxi, China.

pmc-11606445.title: Convergent evolution of berberine biosynthesis
pmc-11606445.creator: Zhichao Xu, Ya Tian, Jing Wang, Yuwei Ma, Qi Li, Yuanze Zhou, Wanran Zhang, Tingxia Liu, Lingzhe Kong, Yifan Wang, Ziyan Xie, Zhoujie An, Baojiang Zheng, Yuhong Zhang, Chang Cao, Chengwei Liu, Lixia Tian, Chengpeng Fan, Jiushi Liu, Hui Yao, Jingyuan Song, Baozhong Duan, Haitao Liu, Ranran Gao, Wei S
pmc-11606445.description: Berberine is an effective antimicrobial and antidiabetic alkaloid, primarily extracted from divergent botanical lineages, specifically Coptis (Ranunculales, early-diverging eudicot) and Phellodendron (Sapindales, core eudicot). In comparison with its known pathway in Coptis species, its biosynthesis in Phellodendron species remains elusive.

pmc-11672532.title: Reconfigurable Amphiphilic DNA Nanotweezer for Targeted Delivery of Therapeutic Oligonucleotides
pmc-11672532.creator: Shuxuan Shao, Wei Du, Shuang Liu, Canqiong Hu, Cao Zhang, Lexun Li, Fan Yang, Qiaoling Liu, Weihong Tan
pmc-11672532.description: Amphiphilic lipid oligonucleotide conjugates are powerful molecular-engineering materials that have been used for delivery of therapeutic oligonucleotides. However, conventional lipid oligonucleotide conjugates suffer from poor selectivity to target cells due to the nonspecific interaction between lipid tails and cell membranes.

pmc-12995469.title: Mapping review on breaking bad news and design of SAFE & CARING protocol for pediatric hematology-oncology
pmc-12995469.creator: Theresia Krieger, Lisa Frey, Marc Hoemberg, Kerstin Dittmer
pmc-12995469.description: Objective(1) to map existing Breaking Bad News (BBN) protocols and (2) to develop a context-specific, practical “first aid” triadic communication protocol, for the German pediatric hematology-oncology (PHO) setting where no such tool currently exists.MethodsA mapping review was conducted to systematically identify existing BBN protocols.

pmc-13287857.title: 26: Rapid Autopsy Unravels Clonal Drivers of Metastatic Progression in FGFR2-Driven Cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-13287857.creator: Ankur Sheel, Anoosha Paruchuri, Eric Samorodnitsky, Julie Reeser, Michele Wing, Amy Smith, Thuy Dao, Raven Vela, Emily Hoskins, Zachary Risch, Sameek Roychowdhury
pmc-13287857.description: Background & ObjectivesCholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is a highly aggressive disease with a 5-year survival of ∼9%. FGFR2 aberrations, including gene fusions and activating point mutations, occur in ∼10% of CCA cases and represent a targetable driver. Although FGFR inhibitors show clinical promise, resistance and metastatic progression remain major challenges.

pmc-13655911.creator: Su-Hua Xu, Ting-Ting Li, Chong-Bing Yan, Huan-Huan Zhang, Xiao-Hui Gong, Cheng Cai
pmc-13655911.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the associations between severity classified by three bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) diagnostic criteria [2001 National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD), 2018 NICHD, and 2019 Jensen] and cerebral injury identified on term-equivalent age (TEA) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in infants born at <32 weeks’ gestation.

pmc-13675719.title: Locally Estimated Scatterplot Smoothing for Censored Survival Data
pmc-13675719.creator: David van Klaveren, Peter C. Austin, Patrick W. Serruys, Ben van Calster, Frank E. Harrell
pmc-13675719.description: In the absence of censoring, locally estimated scatterplot smoothing (LOESS) is a powerful tool to estimate the relationship between a continuous covariate and the probability of an event and is often used to visually assess calibration of prognostic models. Since follow‐up in prognostic studies is often incomplete, we aimed to study the extension of LOESS to right‐censored data.
